info.name: Student Management API
info.description:
Software Testing AAT: Automated API Testing with Postman and Newman.
Team: Kaustubh, Aayush Jalan, Utsav Adhikari (BMSCE).

Each folder is a test suite and starts with a `[setup] Reset data` request. Run the Data-Driven folder with `postman/data/students.csv` as the data file.
